Farina Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:41pm

Ingredients




1 cup sugar
1/2 cup water
1/4 cup butter
3 cups cooked cream of wheat
1/2 cup honey
1/2 cup chopped walnuts

Preparation

1 Boil sugar and water until thick and syrupy, about 15 minutes. Add butter and farina and stir until completely blended. The mixture should be quite thick. Pour into dish, sprinkle the honey and walnuts on top.
